author: spacewitch244
quote: Boring storyline and unlikeable main characters. As a female gamer I’m just going to say Lucia is just insufferable. Jason has zero personality. I’ve played every GTA and this just doesn’t feel like GTA. Good graphics don’t make a game good. This game simply did not live up to the hype. This has ruined gta’s reputation forever.
